records.needling: 直刺 0.5-1 寸；孕期慎用或禁用，膀胱充盈時禁深刺。
records.location_en: On the lower abdomen, 3 cun inferior to the centre of the umbilicus, on the anterior median line.
functions_en: Tonifies original qi, nourishes kidney yin and yang, regulates the lower jiao.

records.needling: 直刺 0.5-1 寸；孕期慎用，腹部深刺需謹慎。
records.location_en: On the lower abdomen, 1.5 cun inferior to the centre of the umbilicus, on the anterior median line.
functions_en: Tonifies qi, regulates qi movement, benefits the lower jiao.

records.needling: 直刺 0.5-1 寸；上腹部深刺需避開腹腔與臟器深部結構。
records.location_en: On the upper abdomen, 4 cun superior to the centre of the umbilicus, on the anterior median line.
functions_en: Harmonizes the stomach, fortifies the spleen, resolves dampness. Front-mu point of the stomach.

records.needling: 平刺 0.3-0.5 寸；不可深直刺，胸部深刺有氣胸風險。
records.location_en: On the anterior thoracic region, at the same level as the 4th intercostal space, on the anterior median line.
functions_en: Regulates qi and unbinds the chest, benefits breathing. Front-mu point of the pericardium and hui-meeting point of qi.

records.needling: 向鼻尖方向斜刺 0.5-1 寸；禁向內上深刺，避開延髓區。
records.location_en: On the anterior aspect of the neck, inferior to the occipital bone, in the depression between sternocleidomastoid and trapezius.
functions_en: Dispels wind, clears the head, benefits the eyes and ears, relaxes the sinews.

records.needling: 直刺 0.3-0.5 寸或向外斜刺；不可深刺，肩井深刺有氣胸風險，孕期慎用或禁用。
records.location_en: On the shoulder girdle, in the depression between the anterior border of trapezius and the superior border of the clavicle, midway between GV14 and the acromion.
functions_en: Regulates qi, benefits the shoulders and neck, promotes descending. Meeting point of gallbladder and several channels.

records.needling: 直刺 1.5-3 寸；避開坐骨神經，深刺需掌握方向。
records.location_en: On the buttock, at the junction of the lateral third and medial two-thirds of the line connecting the greater trochanter with the sacral hiatus.
functions_en: Benefits the hip and leg, activates the channel, dispels wind-damp.

records.location_en: On the fibular aspect of the leg, in the depression anterior and distal to the head of the fibula.
functions_en: Benefits the sinews and joints, spreads liver qi, clears damp-heat. He-sea point and hui-meeting point of sinews.

records.location_en: On the fibular aspect of the leg, 3 cun proximal to the prominence of the lateral malleolus, anterior to the fibula.
functions_en: Benefits marrow, sinews and bones, clears gallbladder heat. Hui-meeting point of marrow.

records.needling: 向下斜刺 0.5-1 寸；不可向上深刺。
records.location_en: On the posterior median line, in the depression inferior to the spinous process of the 7th cervical vertebra.
functions_en: Clears heat, releases the exterior, regulates yang qi.

records.needling: 沿頭皮平刺 0.5-1 寸。
records.location_en: On the head, 5 cun superior to the anterior hairline, on the anterior median line.
functions_en: Raises yang, clears the head, calms the spirit.

records.needling: 向上斜刺 0.3-0.5 寸；面部針感較強。
records.location_en: On the face, at the junction of the upper one third and lower two thirds of the philtrum midline.
functions_en: Restores consciousness, benefits the lumbar spine, regulates the Governing Vessel.

records.needling: 避開腋動脈，直刺 0.3-0.5 寸；不作大幅提插。
避開尺動脈與尺神經，直刺 0.3-0.5 寸。

避開尺動脈，直刺 0.3-0.5 寸。
records.location_en: At the ulnar end of the palmar wrist crease, in the depression radial to the tendon of flexor carpi ulnaris, at the radial side of the pisiform bone.
functions_en: Calms the heart and spirit. Shu-stream, earth and yuan-source point of the heart channel.

records.needling: 直刺 0.3-0.5 寸；掌部針感較強。
淺刺 0.1 寸，或點刺出血。
直刺 0.5-1 寸；孕期慎用或禁用。
records.location_en: On the dorsum of the hand, radial to the midpoint of the second metacarpal bone.
functions_en: Regulates defensive qi, releases the exterior, benefits the face and sensory orifices. Yuan-source point of the large intestine channel.

records.location_en: On the lateral aspect of the elbow, at the midpoint of the line connecting LU5 with the lateral epicondyle of the humerus.
functions_en: Clears heat, cools blood, resolves dampness, regulates qi and blood. He-sea point of the large intestine channel.

records.needling: 向鼻翼方向斜刺 0.3-0.5 寸。
records.location_en: On the face, in the nasolabial sulcus, level with the midpoint of the lateral border of the ala nasi.
functions_en: Opens the nasal passages, disperses wind and heat.

records.location_en: On the dorsum of the foot, in the depression distal to the junction of the 1st and 2nd metatarsal bones.
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, subdues liver yang, extinguishes wind, nourishes liver blood and yin. Shu-stream and yuan-source point of the liver channel.

records.needling: 沿肋間隙斜刺或平刺 0.3-0.5 寸；不可深直刺，胸脅部深刺有氣胸風險。
records.location_en: On the anterior thoracic region, in the 6th intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior median line.
functions_en: Spreads liver qi, harmonizes the stomach, unbinds the chest. Front-mu point of the liver.

records.needling: 向外斜刺或平刺 0.5-0.8 寸；不可向內深刺，深部為肺臟，有氣胸風險。
records.location_en: On the anterior chest wall, in the 1st intercostal space, 6 cun lateral to the anterior midline, 1 cun inferior to LU2.
functions_en: Diffuses and downbears lung qi, stops cough and wheezing. Front-mu point of the lung.

records.needling: 向外斜刺 0.5-0.8 寸；不可向內深刺，深部為肺臟，有氣胸風險。
直刺 0.8-1.2 寸，或點刺出血；避開肱動脈分支。
records.location_en: On the cubital crease, in the depression lateral to the biceps brachii tendon.
functions_en: Clears lung heat, downbears counterflow qi. He-sea and water point of the lung channel.

records.needling: 向肘部斜刺或平刺 0.5-0.8 寸。
records.location_en: Proximal to the radial styloid process, 1.5 cun proximal to the wrist crease, between brachioradialis and abductor pollicis longus tendons.
functions_en: Diffuses the lung, releases the exterior, benefits the head and neck. Luo-connecting point; confluent point of the Conception Vessel.

records.needling: 避開橈動脈，直刺 0.1-0.3 寸。
避開橈動脈，直刺 0.2-0.3 寸。
records.location_en: At the radial end of the palmar wrist crease, in the depression between the radial styloid and the scaphoid, radial to the radial artery.
functions_en: Supplements lung qi, transforms phlegm, promotes the vessels. Shu-stream, yuan-source point; hui-meeting of the vessels.

records.needling: 淺刺 0.1 寸，或三稜針點刺出血。
直刺 0.5-1 寸；避開正中神經，針感可向手掌放散。
records.location_en: On the anterior aspect of the forearm, between palmaris longus and flexor carpi radialis tendons, 2 cun proximal to the palmar wrist crease.
functions_en: Regulates the heart and calms the spirit, harmonizes the stomach and downbears counterflow. Luo-connecting point and confluent point of the Yin Linking Vessel.

records.needling: 直刺 0.8-1.2 寸；孕期慎用，腹部深刺需避開腹腔與腹膜。
records.location_en: On the abdomen, 2 cun lateral to the centre of the umbilicus.
functions_en: Regulates the intestines, resolves dampness, regulates qi. Front-mu point of the large intestine.

records.needling: 直刺 1-2 寸。
records.location_en: On the anterior aspect of the leg, 3 cun inferior to ST35, one finger-breadth lateral to the anterior crest of the tibia.
functions_en: Harmonizes the stomach, strengthens the spleen, tonifies qi and blood. He-sea point of the stomach channel.

records.location_en: On the anterior aspect of the leg, 8 cun superior to the lateral malleolus, lateral to the anterior crest of the tibia.
functions_en: Transforms phlegm, harmonizes the stomach, clears the spirit. Luo-connecting point of the stomach channel.

records.location_en: On the dorsum of the foot, between the 2nd and 3rd toes, proximal to the web margin.
functions_en: Clears stomach heat, regulates the intestines, reduces swelling and pain. Ying-spring point of the stomach channel.

records.location_en: On the posterior aspect of the forearm, 2 cun proximal to the dorsal wrist crease, between the radius and ulna.
functions_en: Releases the exterior, benefits the head and ears, clears channel heat. Luo-connecting point and confluent point of the Yang Linking Vessel.
